answer.rationale: memory_73 (promotional pricing) scores lowest because price-based competition creates a race-to-bottom dynamic that erodes margins and attracts price-sensitive customers with weaker lifetime value and higher churn risk—directly opposed to sustainable long-term qualified revenue. It shows acquisition and revenue lift in the moment but omits retention, margin impact, and customer quality metrics critical to sustainability. memory_44, memory_91, memory_31, and memory_86 all directly support sustainable revenue through pipeline quality, engagement depth, activation durability, and speed-to-value respectively. memory_57 (referral incentives) scores well because it generates qualified inbound from existing customers—a high-trust, durable channel with proven retention compatibility.
